ninesliceComponent.name: Base
ninesliceComponent.event: component("topHeight"):SetFloat(50.0) component("bottomHeight"):SetFloat(50.0) component("leftWidth"):SetFloat(50.0) component("rightWidth"):SetFloat(50.0) component("size"):SetFloat(0.5 * game.windowScaleY()) component("includeBorder"):SetInt(1) component("spriteName"):SetString("gfx/clubbox/prize_slot_teal_9s") component("layer"):SetString("$layer")

touchComponent.name: Touch
touchComponent.event: element.touchTimer = 0 element.isTooltipShowing = false element.shouldHideTooltip = true element.startX = -1 element.startY = -1 component:GetVar("passthrough"):SetInt(1)
if not element.isTooltipShowing then element.shouldHideTooltip = false element.Tooltip:setText(element.TooltipText) element.Tooltip:Show() element.isTooltipShowing = true end

event.name: onTouchDrag
event.params: component, element, x, y, relX, relY, dx, dy

touchComponent.event: if element.isTooltipShowing then if element.startX == -1 then element.startX = x element.startY = y end local diffX = element.startX - x local diffY = element.startY - y if diffX*diffX + diffY*diffY > 256 * game.windowScaleY() then element.shouldHideTooltip = true element.touchTimer = 0 end end

if element.shouldHideTooltip then element.touchTimer = element.touchTimer - dt if element.touchTimer < 0 and element.isTooltipShowing then element.Tooltip:Hide() element.isTooltipShowing = false element.shouldHideTooltip = false element.startX = -1 element.startY = -1 end end
